RAC Media Centre — "Pump prices rise again"
Publication date: 13/07/2026

PETROL (unleaded):
- High of 159.53p per litre at end of May 2026 (Iran war high)
- Low of 150.59p per litre on 6 July 2026
- 151.19p per litre as at Monday 13 July 2026

DIESEL:
- High of 191.54p per litre in mid-April 2026
- Conflict low of 164.52p per litre
- 164.85p per litre as at Monday 13 July 2026

NAMED QUOTE:
Simon Williams, RAC Head of Policy:
"Pump prices have started rising again on the back of last week's increase in the cost of oil"

CONTEXT (from secondary reporting, NOT confirmed in RAC article text):
Reports elsewhere suggest petrol rose a further ~1.18p since 6 July to ~151.77p, and that
RAC expects petrol and diesel to rise "a couple of pence a litre more in the next week or so"
depending on further US-Iran attacks. TREAT AS UNCONFIRMED unless re-verified on rac.co.uk.
